renderDetails.messageTitle: Message from vidIQ tool schema reader (research)

content:
Here is the summary of all 28 vidIQ MCP tool schemas requested:

### Summary Table of vidIQ MCP Tools

| Tool Name | One-Line Purpose | Key Required Params | Credits Mentioned? | Cost / Tier Info |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `vidiq_keyword_research` | Research YouTube keywords for search volume, competition scores, in-country volume, and related/rising terms. | Mode-dependent (`country` required for `country_top`; `country` & `keyword` for `country_search`; `keyword` for `research`) | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_generate_script` | Generate a full long-form video script asynchronously from a topic, title, concept, and research. | `topic`, `title`, `concept`, `research` | Yes | **1 credit(s) per minute of script** (`lengthMinutes`). Auto-refunded if generation fails |
| `vidiq_score_title` | Score a YouTube video title for click-through-rate (CTR) potential on a 0-100 scale. | `title`, `type` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_generate_titles` | Generate scored YouTube title suggestions based on video metadata or seed parameters. | None in JSON schema (requires at least one of `videoId`, `title`, or `description`) | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_generate_thumbnail` | Asynchronously generate a YouTube thumbnail image from video metadata, prompts, or reference images. | None in JSON schema (requires at least one of `videoId`, `title`, `description`, or `userQuery`) | Yes | **22 credit(s)** per call. Auto-refunded if generation fails |
| `vidiq_score_thumbnail` | Score a YouTube thumbnail for CTR potential with feedback on strengths and improvements. | `videoId`, `title` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_outliers` | Discover viral, breakout, and overperforming YouTube videos that outperform channel averages. | None | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_trending_videos` | Discover currently trending YouTube videos gaining views rapidly based on views-per-hour velocity. | `videoFormat` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_channel_stats` | Get current stats (subscribers, views, video count) and historical growth for any YouTube channel. | `channelId` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_similar_channels` | Find competitor and similar YouTube channels relative to a target channel using neural semantic search. | `niche` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_similar_videos` | Find high-performing YouTube videos similar to a seed video based on text and visual thumbnail matching. | `videoId` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_video_stats` | Retrieve historical performance metrics (views, likes, comments, VPH) for a specific video over time. | `videoId`, `granularity` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_video_transcript` | Retrieve full text transcripts and captions for a given YouTube video. | `videoId` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_video_comments` | Retrieve YouTube comment threads and replies for a specific video or channel. | None in JSON schema (requires either `videoId` or `channelId`) | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_video_earnings_estimate` | Estimate ad-revenue earnings range (USD) for a specific YouTube video using vidIQ's RPM model. | `videoId` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_channel_videos` | Retrieve recent or top popular videos from a specific channel filtered by format (long, short, live). | `channelId`, `videoFormat` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_compose` | Asynchronously assemble scenes, voiceover, music, and overlays into a rendered MP4 video. | `scenes`, `format` | Yes | **1 credit(s) per 4s of output video** (min 2 credits). Auto-refunded if render fails |
| `vidiq_balance` | Check the user's available vidIQ credits in renewable and add-on credit buckets. | None | Yes | **0 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_channel_search` | Search YouTube channels using semantic/lexical text search and comprehensive metadata filters. | None in JSON schema (requires at least one of `query`, `handle`, `channelTitle`, or filters) | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_motion_graphics` | Asynchronously author and render animated motion graphics and typography cards into an MP4 video. | `durationSeconds`, `root` | Yes | **1 credit(s) per 4s of output** (min 2 credits). Auto-refunded if render fails |
| `vidiq_generate_broll` | Search and fetch free stock B-roll video clips with creator attribution. | `query` | Yes | **1 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_voiceover_generate` | Asynchronously generate a voiceover MP3 audio file from text using a specified voice ID. | `script`, `voiceId` | Yes | **14 credit(s) per 1000 characters of script** (rounded up). Auto-refunded if generation fails |
| `vidiq_voiceover_list_voices` | List available standard and custom voiceover voices for speech synthesis. | None | Yes | **0 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_generate_video` | Asynchronously generate AI video clips from text prompts using models like Sora-2, Veo-3.1, or Kling. | `prompt`, `resolution`, `duration` | Yes | **Duration (s) × model rate × 20 credits** (quoted at submit). Auto-refunded if generation fails |
| `vidiq_generate_clips` | Asynchronously slice long videos into vertical short clips with captions based on key moments or prompts. | None in JSON schema (requires `videoUrl` OR `uploadedVideoUrl` + `videoDuration` + `videoFilename`) | Yes | **9 credit(s) per minute of source video** (rounded up). Auto-refunded if generation fails |
| `vidiq_refine_thumbnail` | Asynchronously modify or edit an existing YouTube thumbnail image using text instructions. | `instructions` | Yes | **22 credit(s)** per call. Auto-refunded if refinement fails |
| `vidiq_channel_analytics` | Query official YouTube Analytics performance metrics for authorized owned channels. | `channelId` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
| `vidiq_earnings_calculate` | Calculate estimated monthly YouTube ad revenue for a given monthly view count and niche/geo scenario. | `subject`, `monthlyViews`, `category` | Yes | **5 credit(s)** per call |
